title: The Association Between Autoimmune or Inflammation and Thyroid Disease
brief_summary: This study aims to evaluate the effects of thyroid functions on energy homeostasis and inflammation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects visits outpatient department due to a suspicion of thyroid disease

Exclusion Criteria:

* Psychological disorders, severe inflammatory or infection diseases.
study_population: Subjects with a suspicion of thyroid disease.
